title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement

content.problemStatement:
Given a string s consisting of uppercase English letters and an integer k, you can replace at most k characters.
Return the length of the longest substring containing the same letter after at most k replacements.
content.inputFormat:
First line: String s

Second line: Integer k
